source_id.str: NCI human tumor cell line growth inhibition assay. Data for the HCT-15 Colon cell line

descr.name: NCI human tumor cell line growth inhibition assay. Data for the HCT-15 Colon cell line
description: Growth inhibition of the HCT-15 human Colon tumor cell line is measured as a screen for anti-cancer activity. Cells are grown in 96 well plates and exposed to the test compound for 48 hours. Compounds are tested at 5 different concentrations and three endpoints are estimated from this dose response curve: GI50, concentration required for 50% inhibition of growth, TGI, the concentration requires for complete inhibition of growth, and LC50, the concentration required for 50% reduction in cell number. These estimates are done by simple linear interpolation between the concentrations that surround the approriate level. If a compound doesn't cause inhibition to the appropriate level, the endpoint is set to the highest concentration tested.
comment: These data are a subset of the data from the NCI human tumor cell line screen. Compounds are identified by the NCI NSC number. In the NCI numbering system, HCT-15 is panel number 4, cell number 15
Basically compounds  with LogGI50 (unit M) less than -6 were considered as active. Activity score was based on increasing values of -LogGI50.

source_id.str: NCI human tumor cell line growth inhibition assay. Data for the OVCAR-3 Ovarian cell line

descr.name: NCI human tumor cell line growth inhibition assay. Data for the OVCAR-3 Ovarian cell line
description: Growth inhibition of the OVCAR-3 human Ovarian tumor cell line is measured as a screen for anti-cancer activity. Cells are grown in 96 well plates and exposed to the test compound for 48 hours. Compounds are tested at 5 different concentrations and three endpoints are estimated from this dose response curve: GI50, concentration required for 50% inhibition of growth, TGI, the concentration requires for complete inhibition of growth, and LC50, the concentration required for 50% reduction in cell number. These estimates are done by simple linear interpolation between the concentrations that surround the approriate level. If a compound doesn't cause inhibition to the appropriate level, the endpoint is set to the highest concentration tested.
comment: These data are a subset of the data from the NCI human tumor cell line screen. Compounds are identified by the NCI NSC number. In the NCI numbering system, OVCAR-3 is panel number 6, cell number 1
Basically compounds  with LogGI50 (unit M) less than -6 were considered as active. Activity score was based on increasing values of -LogGI50.
